title: BugMeNot has closed
why_read: End of a long-running, culturally notable internet utility; more a nostalgia/internet-history story than a technical one.
analysis: BugMeNot was a community-maintained site that let people bypass mandatory website registrations by sharing shared login credentials. Its closure marks the end of a long-standing piece of internet infrastructure that touched on debates about free access, site registration walls, and account sharing. There's no technical innovation here, just a notable service shutting down, so the interest is mostly historical and ethical rather than engineering-focused.
